description: §5.2 "Static executable values (S464)": a static `href="javascript:…"` (top level), a static `srcdoc`, a static `vbscript:` href in an `<each>` row, and a static SVG `<set to="javascript:…">` animating `href` are each E-ATTR-STATIC-EXECUTABLE; a relative href and a raster `data:image/png` src stay legal.
rationale: §5.2 (S464): "Any static `srcdoc`" and "A static URL-valued attribute whose scheme is not admitted" SHALL each be a compile error (E-ATTR-STATIC-EXECUTABLE). Before the ruling each was written into the page as the author wrote it, and the browser ran it.
